title: A unified framework for efficient quantum simulation of nonlinear spectroscopy
summary: Nonlinear spectroscopy is a cornerstone of quantum science, providing unique access to multi-point correlations, quantum coherence, and couplings that are invisible to linear methods. However, classical simulation of these phenomena is fundamentally limited by the exponential growth of the Hilbert space, and practical quantum algorithms for the nonlinear regime have remained largely unexplored.
